item.summary: H100 Group AB has entered into a partnership with Coinbase for institutional custody, trading and financing of its bitcoin holdings through Coinbase Prime and Deribit, according to a company notice on 16 November 2026. The company says it holds about 3,506 bitcoin. On its own price basis of USD 64,600 on 15 November 2026, it valued those holdings at about USD 226 million, or SEK 2.3 billion. The notice describes a longer-term ambition to develop investor services; it does not say that an asset-management product has been launched.
